method.source: arXiv:2610.27812v1 (version, title and method notes per unverified search-index excerpts; full text not retrieved). The excerpts name it (SliMOO, submitted 2026-10-20). This reproduces the issue's formula. Excerpts, unverified, describe: single-unit removal probing per task and a max-over-tasks prior. Deviations from the excerpts: neurons not transformer layers; fixed fitSeed temperature grid, not tau adapted from hypervolume progress; bounded archive on worst-stratum loss, synapses and latency, not NSGA-II on per-task losses; lowest-loss selection, not hypervolume contribution; no mixed random initial population
method.importance: I[t][i] = baseline score minus the score with neuron i removed alone (core prune, step-2 mean), per calibration stratum
method.scales: s_t = median over measured neurons of |I[t][i]|; 1.0 when that median is not above 1e-12; N = I / s
method.statistics: aggregate a_i = sum_t w_t N[t][i] with calibration record weights; worst m_i = max_t N[t][i]
method.sampler: k distinct neurons drawn without replacement, P(i) proportional to exp(-(x_i - min x) / tau); the random arm draws uniformly
method.temperatureFit: per informed arm and candidate tau, bundlesPerArm bundles from fitSeed scored on calibration; highest mean calibration score wins, ties to the earliest tau
method.evaluation: per seed and arm: bundlesPerArm bundles built canonically; pareto draws paretoCandidates, drops repeated member sets, full-scores the bundlesPerArm lowest by predicted cost, and keeps the non-dominated archive on measured worst-stratum loss, synapses and latency; the winner is the largest calibration delta above minImprovement, and pareto takes the lowest-loss archived win instead
method.validation: after every arm of a seed has selected, the winners are scored once per validation stratum; validation never feeds back into a choice
method.latency: median of three wall-clock passes over the first latencyRecords calibration records, ms per record (indicative only)

criteria.rule: met iff regressionReduction >= minRegressionReduction AND meanFitnessDifference >= -maxFitnessLoss, where regressionReduction = aggregate minority regressions - arm minority regressions and meanFitnessDifference = arm mean validationDelta - aggregate mean validationDelta
